function.name: start_claim
function.description: Take down a new loss the caller is reporting, for a verified caller or a new caller whose details were confirmed on this call. Call it once you know what happened and when, and again with every detail, corrected, after the caller says the read-back was wrong. Its result is a sentence that has already been spoken to the caller: it reads the claim back and asks whether it is correct, or asks for what is still missing.

claim_type.description: auto for a car or another vehicle; home for the caller's own home; property for anything else, such as a rental property, a boat or their belongings.

loss_date.description: When it happened, exactly as the caller said it, such as "yesterday", "on Sunday" or "October tenth", including a day they mentioned in passing while telling what happened. Never work out, convert or guess the date yourself.

description.description: What happened, in the caller's own words. Never a date of birth, a phone number or a policy number.

summary.description: A few plain words for the read-back, at most eight, that fit after "a claim for", in the third person, never "I", "my" or "we", such as "a cracked windshield" or "a tree on the roof".

messages.content: Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
I'm sorry, I couldn't take down those details just now. I can have a claims specialist call you back to help. Would you like that?
